RIQ01.name: IQueryable as public API / leaky abstraction / repository boundary
RIQ01.meaning: IQueryable and LINQ in repository/public API: leaky abstraction, arbitrary expressions, EF Core implementation details leaking, alternative IEnumerable interface, filtering arguments, and design-by-contract discussion.

RIQ02.name: Returning IEnumerable without ToList / materialization boundary
RIQ02.meaning: Returning IEnumerable<T> while query is still deferred: when it is okay, when ToList materializes inside the method, LINQ after return no longer composes to SQL, IEnumerator model, lazy evaluation, and disposed DbContext risk.

RIQ03.name: Multiple enumeration hazards for IEnumerable
RIQ03.meaning: Problems caused by enumerating deferred IEnumerable sequences multiple times: repeated side effects, partial enumeration changing behavior, hidden database queries outside repository boundary, disposed resources, different results on each enumeration, and expensive work repeated.

RIQ04.name: Async enumerable repeated enumeration / caching / single-use streams
RIQ04.meaning: IEnumerable and IAsyncEnumerable deferred sequence behavior: foreach/await foreach reruns logic, ToList/ToListAsync caches once, repeated async enumeration can repeat database calls/HTTP/delays/streams, and some async enumerables should be treated as single-use.

RIQ05.name: Yield / iterator cleanup / finally restrictions
RIQ05.meaning: C# iterator and async iterator cleanup semantics: yield return restrictions in catch/finally, early stop disposal, finally cleanup, GetEnumerator/Dispose behavior, and async iterator finally behavior.
